events.name: SpaceX (SPCX) share-eligibility unlock, up to ~319 million shares
events.reason: Second post-IPO lock-up expiration (70th day after the June pricing per the final prospectus) -- roughly 20% growth in tradable float. Correction from this report's own prior tracking: this is the SAME event previously also described as a distinct ~7% tranche 'around Aug 21' -- it is one event, not two. FINRA short volume in SPCX ran 62% of total volume Wednesday (Aug 19), elevated versus a typical 40-50% range, consistent with pre-unlock hedging rather than a directional short bet. The Aug 6 first unlock saw the stock rise on the day rather than fall.
